blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Technology & SaaS level this capability reads as: product events into governed analytics with feature-level cost attribution (product decisions on real unit economics). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Below is the delivery cadence for this capability — the same pattern on every engagement. Weeks 1–2 are measurement only: we lock the current metric with your team and both sides sign it before a line of build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver a bounded pilot — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a named control owner on your side. Weeks 9–12 turn what worked into runbooks, monitoring and enablement, then report the measured delta against the baseline. A missed gate means a documented stop-or-redirect decision, not a quiet extension.
